summary: Frontend-only test of (P0) homepage taxonomy hero search -> /tenders/all and (P1) country<->currency model (Masters > Country currencies + notice CurrencySelect). Found and FIXED a critical bug: a legacy document-level submit listener in PmcLinkPatcher.jsx was hijacking the new hero form. It routed to /tenders/live and put the selected Sector's text into ?country= (e.g. /tenders/live?q=road&country=Biomass+%26+Waste-to-Energy). After a 1-line guard, all 4 requested flows pass.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. It intercepted every form.pmc-hero__search and navigated to /tenders/live?country=<text of FIRST select>. React's onSubmit ran first, then this listener overrode it, so the hero sent users to the wrong board with Sector name as country. Fix: skip forms whose data-testid is 'home-hero-search'.
/tenders/all shows the hero title 'Live tenders' even though the 'All' mode pill is active. The non-E title logic has 'All published notices', but the E hero seems to hard-code 'Live tenders'.

integration_issues.issue: When the country changes, the primary is applied only if the current value is NOT in the new country's accepted list. Switching US (USD) -> IN keeps USD, not INR (the IN primary). This may be intended, but it contradicts 'default-load the selected country's primary'. Consider always applying the primary on a user-driven country change (create form).

issues: 'Accepted in IN' group is ordered alphabetically (EUR, INR, USD), so the primary is not listed first
Delivery country InfoDot still says 'Pulled from the 30-country master', but the dropdown has 250 countries
The sonner success toast (top-right) overlaps the masters tab bar and hides the 'Country currencies' tab label while it shows

action_items: Review the fix in /app/frontend/src/components/PmcLinkPatcher.jsx onSubmit (guard for data-testid=home-hero-search). Consider removing the legacy hero submit handler entirely now that HeroTaxonomySearch owns submit.
E-theme TendersList hero: use the mode-aware title ('All published notices' for mode=all)
Optional: CurrencySelect should apply the primary on any explicit country change in create forms, and list the primary first in the Accepted group
Update the notice-country InfoDot text ('30-country master')
critical_code_review_comments: PmcLinkPatcher global DOM listeners (click/submit) override React-owned components by className. This is fragile, and any new component reusing pmc-* classes can be hijacked. Gate these listeners on an explicit opt-in data attribute instead of className.

HeroTaxonomySearch sends category by NAME (value=c.name); TendersList matches it with substring includes on n.category/category_code. It works but is inconsistent with sector/contract, which use codes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after fix (hero search failed before the fix)

Contract epc-construction + Category -> /tenders/all?contract=...&category=...; contract and category filters restored; '2 applied'

Notice create: default KZ -> KZT; select IN -> notice-currency=INR with groups 'Accepted in IN' (3) + 'All currencies' (22); manual GBP selection works

context_for_next_testing_agent: The hero submit hijack is fixed in PmcLinkPatcher.jsx. If the hero ever routes to /tenders/live again, check document-level listeners in PmcLinkPatcher and pmcEPublicNav.js. Repeated admin logins in quick succession sometimes left the user on the login page, so wait for the URL to match **/admin/e/** after submit.
rca of the issue: Repro: on '/', choose Sector + Country, click Find tenders -> URL /tenders/live?q=road&country=Biomass+%26+Waste-to-Energy. Cause: PmcLinkPatcher.jsx adds document.addEventListener('submit') for '.pmc-hero__search', reads the first <select> (now Sector) option TEXT as country, and calls navigate('/tenders/live...') after React's own navigate, so the last navigate wins. Mitigation: early return when form data-testid === 'home-hero-search'. Verified fixed.
